known_limitations.boundary: No verified distributable standalone historical Gleason scan/control points are embedded.
Gleason normalized-radius is not converted to metres/kilometres without a declared basis.
Missing WGS84 ellipsoidal height remains unknown; ECEF is unavailable without explicit height.
Astronomy/time service is unavailable in Phase 5.
Shared cross-model layer synchronization is unavailable in Phase 5.

P6.3 implements WGS84 geodesic distance, P6.4 AE projected-plane distance, P6.5 Gleason normalized native distance, and P6.6 is implementing model-specific polygon perimeter/area. Provider-backed road/flight paths and turn-by-turn directions remain unavailable.
Model cameras/zoom are intentionally independent and are not numerically synchronized.
P5.8 persists canonical geographic selection only; P6.2 ordered route state is intentionally transient and is not persisted.
